name: lous-links
title: Lous Links
description: One hotkey saves the frontmost window's title and URL to your private lous-links library; a list command searches, opens, stars and deletes.
author: loudog

preferences.name: baseUrl
preferences.title: Base URL
preferences.description: lous-links Worker base URL. Use the workers.dev origin for API calls; https://loudog.uno/links also works (it is base-path aware).

preferences.name: token
preferences.title: Token
preferences.description: Your lous-links key. Sent as ?t=<token> on every request — the documented path for the Shortcut / CLI / agent.

preferences.name: defaultTags
preferences.title: Default Tags
preferences.description: Comma-separated tags applied to every link saved from Raycast (e.g. raycast,inbox).

preferences.name: repoPath
preferences.title: Raycast Repo Path
preferences.description: Checkout that holds extensions/lous-links/sessions/collect.ts — used by the Rebuild Index action in Search Sessions.

commands.name: save-front-link
commands.title: Save Front Link
commands.subtitle: Lous Links
commands.description: Save the frontmost window's title and URL to lous-links

commands.name: save-clipboard-link
commands.title: Save Clipboard Link
commands.subtitle: Lous Links
commands.description: Save every link on the clipboard to lous-links

commands.name: search-links
commands.title: Search Links
commands.subtitle: Lous Links
commands.description: Search, open, star, pin and delete your saved links

commands.name: search-sessions
commands.title: Search Sessions
commands.subtitle: Lous Links
commands.description: Search every Claude, Codex and Hermes session from one place
